revenueModel.text: Leading brands and manufacturers pay the company for business-to-business sales and white label solutions under fixed fee or volume-based revenue models.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company offers both business-to-business sales and "white label" solutions, depending on the needs of customers and the ultimate end use based on either a fixed fee or volume-based revenue model (or both).
